This contract-test transcript describes an engineering demonstration and its limits. The speaker identifies the task, baseline, elapsed time, review burden, and a failure that required human correction. This material is explicitly fictional fixture evidence and supports no real-world conclusion. It is long enough to exercise the pipeline's substantive-content checks. The speaker cautions that a successful demonstration does not establish reliability across repositories, languages, security policies, or team structures. A decision should remain bounded until independent operational evidence is available.
